calculate_elastic_tensor: calculate the elastic tensor, bulk modulus, and shear modulus for an ASE Atoms structure using pymatgen
run_elasticity_with_custom_strains: run elasticity calculations with custom normal and shear strain values on a relaxed crystal structure
compute_bulk_shear_moduli: compute the VRH bulk and shear moduli from an elastic tensor using ASE and pymatgen
calculate_elasticity_without_relaxation: calculate elasticity results on a pre-relaxed structure by disabling initial and strained relaxation steps
calculate_elasticity_with_equilibrium_st: calculate the elastic tensor using equilibrium stress from a relaxed ASE Atoms object
